samples.summary: New comment states a repo-wide default ('a position with none reads as backward') that only holds on some consumer paths
samples.evidence: The added comment asserts that a DocPosition carrying no lineAffinity universally reads as 'backward'. That is true for the caret (packages/docs/src/view/cursor.ts:35 `return this.position.lineAffinity ?? 'backward'`), for findPageForPosition (packages/docs/src/view/pagination.ts:385) and for peer carets (packages/docs/src/view/peer-cursor.ts:105). But other live consumers default the other way: packages/docs/src/view/visual-line.ts:24 `lineAffinity: 'forward' | 'backward' = 'forward'` and packages/docs/src/view/selection.ts:260 `const startAffinity = start.lineAffinity ?? 'forward'`. A reader of this test will take the comment as the contract for the whole affinity feature and may 'simplify' an omitted affinity at one of those two sites, changing rendering. Fix belongs in the comment (scope it to the caret/presence path), not in the source.
